answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 99 identities means 99 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the glacier pair is tracked in the reef ledger, the sparrow audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 24%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
